scenes.text: UPI is getting a fee tomorrow.
Sending money to people: still free.
scenes.sub: Shop payments up to ₹2,000: no fee.

scenes.text: Send this to your family group.

caption:
UPI is getting a fee from 15 October. Here's who actually pays (it's not you).

A 0.4% merchant fee applies to specified UPI payments to shops above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300. Sending money to people stays free, and so do shop payments up to ₹2,000. NPCI says consumers can keep using UPI free.

Source: NPCI FAQ, via SCC Online

Send this to the friend who'll panic when they hear 'UPI fee'.

scenes.text: Your parents will get this call.
"This is CBI. You are under digital arrest."
Real agencies never arrest anyone on a video call.
scenes.sub: CBI, police, ED, customs, judges: never.

caption:
Your parents will get this call. Make sure they know it's a scam.

Fraudsters pose as CBI, police, customs or ED officers on video calls, claim you're caught in a crime, keep you 'under digital arrest' on camera and demand money. The government's cyber crime centre (I4C) says real agencies never arrest anyone on a video call.

Hang up. Don't pay. Report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

Source: I4C advisory, via PTI

Send this to your parents now.
